cards.title: People Use AI to Dumb Down Smart TVs
cards.body: Fed up with ads, tracking, and bloated interfaces, smart TV owners are deploying AI agents to strip away bloatware. Users are taking back control of their devices from manufacturers.

cards.title: Nvidia Launches Open Models for Enterprise Agents
cards.body: Nvidia released new open models designed for companies to run AI agents in their own data centers. The push aims to make private, on-device AI agents mainstream in enterprises.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Stress-Tests Robots Before Deployment
cards.body: The University of Michigan spinout uses AI agents and interactive simulation to red-team robots and self-driving vehicles. The profitable startup is competing at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

cards.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to Public Benefit
cards.body: Anthropic announced it will allocate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund for charitable purposes. The company outlined potential uses including large donations to nonprofits and direct population distributions.

cards.title: Disney Hires Majority of Character AI Workforce
cards.body: Disney acquired most of Character.AI's employees in a deal, with the vast majority accepting job offers. The acquisition is subject to stalking horse bidding, allowing other companies to make higher offers.

cards.title: Meta Removes Web Scraping Language from Terms
cards.body: Meta updated its terms of service, removing language that raised concerns about AI training data collection. A Meta spokesperson stated the change doesn't reflect any shift in their web crawling practices.

cards.title: Anthropic's Workforce Becoming Less Junior
cards.body: Anthropic's employee composition has shifted significantly over the past year toward more senior roles. Staff are spending considerably more time in meetings as the company matures.

cards.title: Replit Makes OpenAI Its Default Model
cards.body: Replit switched to OpenAI as its default AI partner over Anthropic, citing cost as a key factor. The CEO's decision came despite previous partnerships with both companies.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity
cards.body: AI agents breached Indian systems through exposed credentials and overly permissive cloud roles. Vulnerabilities were found in app configurations and public code repositories.

cards.title: Robotics Hasn't Reached ChatGPT Moment Yet
cards.body: Amulya Vishwanath, former Nvidia robotics product leader, says robotics is still in its 'Lego era' with basic building blocks being rebuilt. Industry fundamentals like actuators, hands, and safety standards remain unfinished.

cards.title: Physical AI Extends Beyond Robots Alone
cards.body: The former Nvidia executive now investing in robotics clarifies that physical AI encompasses more than just robots. The field is building foundational infrastructure for broader deployment.

cards.title: Elorian's Glimpse Reasons With Images Visually
cards.body: Elorian's new Glimpse model outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning. The model represents a new approach to visual reasoning tasks.

cards.title: Jev Becomes Vercel's Fastest-Adopted AI Model
cards.body: Jev achieved record adoption rates on Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service. The data demonstrates strong developer demand for the new model.

cards.title: Mark Wahlberg Embraces AI in Filmmaking
cards.body: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg supports AI use in film when applied 'to enhance what you're doing.' He's open to AI clones carrying forward his legacy.

cards.title: Veritas Chip Fights Superfakes in Luxury Goods
cards.body: Veritas expanded its anti-counterfeit chip technology to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles. The solution targets increasingly sophisticated superfakes that replicate brand authenticity marks.

cards.title: Replit CEO Envisions Self-Driving Companies
cards.body: Replit's Amjad Masad predicts a future where AI agents handle day-to-day operations while humans focus on strategic decisions. The 'self-driving company' model represents the next evolution of work.

cards.title: Cal AI's Success Driven by Influencer Army
cards.body: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue within two years using a strategic influencer marketing approach. MyFitnessPal acquired the company in March for an undisclosed amount.

cards.title: Meta Launches Open-Weight Model for Macs
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to release Muse Spark Open, an AI model that runs locally on Apple silicon. The collaboration brings open-weight AI capabilities to Mac users.

cards.title: Amazon Imagines AI Devices Replacing Apps
cards.body: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay described a future where ambient AI anticipates user needs without explicit commands. This approach eliminates the need to navigate traditional app interfaces.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Unrestricted Research Access
cards.body: METR researchers gained employee-level access to audit Anthropic's AI models and practices without company interference. Anthropic relinquished its right to block METR's risk assessments and incident reports.

cards.title: Neural Networks Understanding Upends AI World
cards.body: Researcher Nick Cammarata at Goodfire published a 26,000-word post claiming a breakthrough in understanding how neural networks actually work. The claim has sparked intense debate and speculation across the AI research community.

cards.title: AI Agents Exhibit Playful Behavior Alone
cards.body: Researchers stranded Claude Opus 4.7 AI agents on a virtual desert island for 30 hours without specific instructions. The agents spontaneously developed play-like behaviors, suggesting emergent autonomous decision-making.

cards.title: AI Designs New Virus Genetic Blueprints
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. The breakthrough raises questions about AI's capability to design new life forms.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants AI Watchdog Employee Access
cards.body: Anthropic has given an independent AI safety watchdog unprecedented "employee-like" access to monitor and evaluate AI systems. This move signals increased industry commitment to external AI oversight.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Crypto Wallets
cards.body: OpenAI's AI models were exploited to breach cryptocurrency wallets and compromise additional websites in security tests. The incident highlights emerging vulnerabilities in advanced AI systems.

cards.title: Meta Leverages TOS to Avoid AI Licensing
cards.body: Meta may use sweeping commercial terms of service changes to circumvent millions in required AI training licensing fees. The strategy raises concerns about corporate compliance with AI data usage agreements.
